purpose: Pinned inputs of the three native binaries network/rpc-runtime.mjs runs (build-binaries.sh builds them offline from exactly these).

toolchain.note: base/base 5476069f requires Rust 1.96; Helios's own rust-toolchain.toml says 1.94.0 and is overridden with RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.96.0 (as every tested build was). No toolchain is installed by the build.

base.what: base/base v1.5.1 (MIT): the maintained Base EVM (Helios) and base-consensus-gossip (listener)
base.layout: Helios's opstack/Cargo.toml names ../../vendor-inspect/base-v1.5.1: the build extracts the tarball (top directory stripped) to <work>/vendor-inspect/base-v1.5.1 next to <work>/helios. The listener's tools/prepare-upstream.py extracts its nine crates from the same tarball into upstream/base-5476069f. No other local tree is read.

helios.what: a16z/helios 2af9b418 + enclave-base-evm (4 patches, eeffcc9) + enclave-witness-check (1ec2c1a5, aca81764, ef320298)
helios.preserved: checkpoint/decentralization-20261022: rpc-base-evm-export (eeffcc9 patches) + witness-helios 1ec2c1a5 + aca81764 + ef320298 (P witness-failover/helios; D owns publication)
helios.note: ef320298 changes only opstack/bin/witness-check.rs and opstack/src/witness_check.rs relative to aca81764 (Cargo.lock unchanged), so the Helios CLI built from eeffcc9 (cc962e2b) is functionally the CLI of this commit

dependencies: crates.io packages exactly as each Cargo.lock lists them (cargo verifies every .crate against the lock's checksum); the build is --locked --offline against a provided CARGO_HOME and refuses to resolve or fetch anything

tested.witnessCheckNote: built by P from ef320298 (debug); the aca81764 helpers fab2f1ce (debug) and a3377048 (release) lack the block op and are no longer accepted
tested.heliosNote: cc962e2b was built from eeffcc9; later commits through ef320298 change only the witness-check helper

release.builtWith: scripts/rpc-runtime/build-binaries.sh <work> <helios repo> <listener repo> <base tarball> <cargo home> release <one>, offline (unshare -r -n), CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1, under the host memory guard at 1536 MiB

witnessCheck.superseded: a33770482356c92861b77c3630e840761208c6c183aa5a67db795a44e8f85acf was a release of aca81764 (peak 1529 MiB, 7 MiB under the 1536 MiB allocation); it is not accepted. No release of ef320298 was built in this integration.

helios.blocked: the memory guard stopped the build at 1547 MiB > 1536 MiB while compiling helios-opstack (before the final fat-LTO link), 2026-10-23T06:28-06:38Z, exit 99; not retried and the repo's release profile was not changed. A release Helios needs a larger, reviewed build allocation; until then the tested Helios is the debug build cc962e2b.

release.pathsInBinaries: no build-directory or home path strings in the listener and witness-check release binaries (remapped)

hostTools.flock: util-linux flock (tested 2.42.4 at /usr/bin/flock): --exclusive --nonblock --conflict-exit-code 73 on an inherited fd 3; reviewed absolute path in config hostTools.flock
hostTools.curl: curl with --aws-sigv4 (only with witnessArchive; credentials on stdin as a config file); reviewed absolute path in config hostTools.curl
